crossRefs.note: Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother, Leah. Then…
The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
“Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the saddlebags.
He saw a resting place, that it was good, the land, that it was pleasant. He bows his shoulder to the burden, and…
Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.
Of the children of Issachar, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of…
The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;
About Zebulun he said, “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out; and Issachar, in your tents.
These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were…
